title: Meteorites
hook: This week's dataset is a dataset all about meteorites, where they fell and when they fell! Data comes from the Meteoritical Society by way of NASA. H/t to #TidyTuesday community member Malin Axelsson for sharing this data as an issue on GitHub! If you want to find out more about meteorite classifications, Malin was kind enough to share a wikipedia article as well! If you want to submit a dataset of your own interest, please do so as an Issue on our GitHub! Thanks!
